Class ListOrdered<T>

java.lang.Object
sysmlinjava.common.SysMLAnything
sysmlinjava.attributetypes.SysMLAttributeType
sysmlinjava.attributetypes.ListOrdered<T>
Type Parameters:
T - type of object in the list
All Implemented Interfaces:
ObservableAttribute
public class ListOrdered<T> extends SysMLAttributeType
SysMLinJava representation of an ordered list as a SysML value type. It uses/wraps the jave ArrayList the SysMLAttributeType to provide a familiar list construct that can be used as an attribute of a model element.

As an extension of the SysMLAttributeType, the ListOrdered can be used for parameters in parametric analysis. It can also by used as attributes of parts, ports, items, etc. SysMLinJava includes other attributes types for collections such as the KeyValueMap and QueueFIFO.

Note that comments for most of the actions/operations on the list are not provided as they are rdundant to those provied by the javadoc for the standard ArrayList, See those standard javadocs for details.

    • createUnits

      protected void createUnits()
      Description copied from class: SysMLAttributeType
      Required operation to create/assign the units attribute for this attribute type. The units variable should be assigned with the name of a SysMLUnit instance located in an extension of the SysMLUnits class. An example is as follows: 
      @Override
protected void createUnits()
{
        units = SysMLinJavaUnits.FeetCubic;
}
